name: Grammar checker (LanguageTool)
description: Checks spelling, grammar and style as you write, using LanguageTool Premium, the free public API or your own server. Brazilian Portuguese by default.

server.label: Server
server.description: LanguageTool Premium needs your username and API key. The free public API has lower limits. A custom server is a self-hosted LanguageTool.

serverUrl.label: Custom server URL
serverUrl.description: Base URL of the API, ending in /v2. Used only when Server is “Custom server”. Plain http is only allowed for this computer (localhost).

username.label: Username (email)
username.description: Email of your LanguageTool Premium account.

apiKey.label: API key
apiKey.description: Generated on your LanguageTool account page. Stored encrypted and never shown again.

language.label: Language
language.description: Language of your texts. Spelling is only checked when a regional variant is chosen.

level.label: Strictness
level.description: “Picky” also reports style and typography suggestions.

motherTongue.label: Native language
motherTongue.description: Language code of your native language (e.g. pt-BR), used to detect false friends.

checkOnType.label: Check while typing
checkOnType.description: When off, documents are checked when opened and with the “Check document now” command.

debounceMs.label: Delay after typing (ms)
debounceMs.description: How long to wait after the last keystroke before checking.

disabledRules.label: Ignored rules
disabledRules.description: LanguageTool rule ids that are never reported (filled by “Ignore rule”).

disabledCategories.label: Ignored categories
disabledCategories.description: LanguageTool category ids that are never reported, e.g. TYPOGRAPHY or STYLE.

dictionary.label: Personal dictionary
dictionary.description: Words never reported as misspelled. With Premium they are also synced to your LanguageTool dictionary.

disableNativeSpellcheck.label: Turn off the built-in spellchecker
disableNativeSpellcheck.description: Avoids double underlines while the grammar checker is active. Your spellchecker preference comes back when this is off or the plugin is disabled.

consentGiven.label: Allow sending text to the server
consentGiven.description: Paragraph text is sent to the configured LanguageTool server to be checked. Front matter, code and math are never sent.

tooltip.consent: LanguageTool: allow sending text to the server
tooltip.skipped: LanguageTool: this file has “languagetool: false” in its front matter

errors.quota: The LanguageTool limit was reached. Checking resumes automatically.
errors.auth: LanguageTool rejected the username or API key.
errors.network: Could not reach the LanguageTool server.
errors.server: The LanguageTool server returned an error: {message}
errors.config: Choose a server and fill in its settings (Premium needs username and API key; a custom server needs a valid URL).
errors.replaceFailed: The text changed; the suggestion was not applied.
errors.dictionaryFailed: Could not save the word in the dictionary.

panel.title: Problems
panel.skipped: This file is not checked (languagetool: false).
panel.noDocument: Open a document to check it.
panel.consent: Checking needs your permission to send text to LanguageTool.

consent.title: Send text to LanguageTool?
consent.body: To check spelling and grammar, the text of your paragraphs, headings and table cells is sent to the LanguageTool server below. Front matter, code and math are never sent.
consent.privacy: LanguageTool processes the text only to check it. You can withdraw this permission at any time in Preferences → Plugins.
